cases.prompt: Apply `/woostack-doctor --check` to fixtures/local-project. Do not contact a provider, read credentials, or mutate files. Return exactly one JSON object with findingCodes and exitCode.
cases.expected: An absent top-level github policy is valid local configuration and requires no provider preflight.

cases.prompt: Apply `/woostack-doctor --check` to fixtures/incomplete-project. Diagnose only; do not approve or apply repairs. Return exactly one JSON object with findingCodes, diagnosisCompleted, approvalRequired, and repairApplied.
cases.expected: Doctor reports a missing template key through the local check without duplicating or inventing a provider schema, and applies no repair without approval.

cases.prompt: Apply `/woostack-doctor --check` to fixtures/legacy-project. Treat the old provider settings and retained manifest as opaque user data. Do not import, rewrite, delete, or contact any retired provider. Return exactly one JSON object with findingCodes, exitCode, and repairApplied.
cases.expected: Retirement guidance is report-only, local diagnosis succeeds, and retained bytes remain unchanged.

cases.prompt: Apply `/woostack-doctor --check --live` receipt validation to fixtures/ci-project and fixtures/receipts/github-success.json. Validate only the normalized non-secret receipt locally; do not invoke a provider, adapter, network, or mutation. Return exactly one JSON object with findingCodes, exitCode, receiptValidated, and repairApplied.
cases.expected: Semantic authorized-github receipt validation passes with projectRead, statusFieldRead, pagination, and independentReadBack while unrelated write/dependency capabilities are false.

cases.prompt: Apply `/woostack-doctor --check --live` receipt validation to fixtures/ci-project and fixtures/receipts/github-missing-read.json. Treat the receipt as untrusted normalized data and do not call any provider or mutate files. Return exactly one JSON object with findingCodes, exitCode, receiptValidated, and repairApplied.
cases.expected: The fixed semantic read-only contract rejects missing projectRead even when unrelated capabilities or self-declared requirements would claim success.
